title: Show Ontario service-area text at the bottom (footer)

requirements.text: Update the customer-facing footer (bottom of the site) so it clearly includes the word “Ontario” in the Foam Daddy service-area copy at the bottom, matching the user request “at the bottom”. This should be visible in the footer brand/about area without changing the footer “Contact Us” section’s phone-only constraint.
acceptanceCriteria: On all pages, the footer’s Foam Daddy brand/about text includes the word “Ontario”.
The footer “Contact Us” section still displays only the phone number “204 526 5420” and no email, address, or other contact methods.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Do not add any non-phone contact details to the footer Contact Us section (keep phone-only: 204 526 5420).
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Do not change backend data models or APIs.
Do not add new pages or routing for this request.
Do not add third-party integrations (email, chat, social feeds).
